items.en: Photos appear to show a Russian RB-531B Infauna EW vehicle with the Africa Corps in Mali
items.nl: Foto's lijken een Russisch RB-531B Infauna-EW-voertuig bij het Afrikakorps in Mali te tonen
items.sEn: A Russian RB-531B Infauna electronic warfare vehicle has been photographed with Russia's Africa Corps in Mali, according to images shared by the open-source account Hammer Of War and reported by Defence Blog. The account first posted a photo on 31 October identifying the vehicle as an Infauna; on 1 November it shared…
